content.text:
**EXCLUSIVITY — compliant (preferred).**

No exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation binds Juniper Ridge. § 12.3 affirmatively confirms Customer may engage any supplier and has made "no exclusivity … commitment," and a full-document sweep for exclusivity language surfaced only non-exclusive licence grants, exclusive-remedy and exclusive-forum terms — none restricting our sourcing freedom.

Boundary calls (not double-flagged here):
- **§ 7.2** disclose-and-match is a right-to-match mechanic; it does not bar engaging another provider once honoured → MFN.
- **§ 2.1** take-or-pay volume floor → MINCOMMIT.

No redline proposed.
